errors.evidence: The blue line reaches an accuracy of 1.0 at an initial confidence of 0.92, and then remains stable at a value close to 1.0 (approximately 0.98-1.0), not 0.92 or 0.93.
The orange line does not increase at an initial confidence of 0.94; it is decreasing at that point. Its peak accuracy of ~0.92 occurs at x=0.92. The value at x=0.94 is approximately 0.74.
The orange line declines to an accuracy of approximately 0.08 at an initial confidence of 0.98, not 0.24.
The green line is a dash-dotted line, not a dashed line.
The green line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.22 at an initial confidence of 0.91, not 0.03.
The green line rises to an accuracy of approximately 0.91 at an initial confidence of 0.98, not 0.31. The description completely misrepresents the magnitude of the increase.
The description fails to mention the prominent intersection of the orange and green lines, which occurs between an initial confidence of 0.95 and 0.96.
The description does not mention that the plot has no legend to identify what each line represents.
